AcceptedThread.description:
An accepted review thread the owner echoes back to `/apply`. Reviews are now persisted (ADR
0013), but `/apply` still takes the client's accepted-thread echo — the server re-grounds them
against stored truth (invariant 2), so resolving accepted threads from the stored review row is
optional hardening, out of scope. The surface emits `Thread` SUBCLASSES with extra fields
(`SlopThread.flag`, `FactCheckThread.claim`/`verdict`/`sourceId`) plus the frontend's
`key`/`source`; `CamelModel` is `extra="forbid"`, so a verbatim echo would 422 at the boundary.
This **ignores** the report-only / UI-only extras, keeping just the anchor + `suggestedRevision`
the Corrector needs — and stays a `Thread`, so `ground_thread_anchors` accepts it.
AcceptedThread.title: AcceptedThread

AdminProviderStatus.description:
Everything the Admin Menu needs to render one provider's card: key status + model config.
Flat (not nested) so the frontend reads one object per provider.
AdminProviderStatus.title: AdminProviderStatus

AdminStatus.description: The whole settings page in one GET — one entry per provider.
AdminStatus.title: AdminStatus

AgentFailure.description:
One adjudicator that RAN and degraded (provider refusal / truncation / parse-fail / API
error). Distinct from a null report field, which means the agent didn't apply (e.g. a no-job
draft has no posting → `gatekeeper`/`editor` are null, with no failure). Surfacing the failure
explicitly is invariant 5 ("surface refusal/truncation/parse-fail loudly") on the blocking arm,
which has no SSE `AgentDone(ok=false)` to carry it.
AgentFailure.title: AgentFailure

AgentReport.description:
One adjudicator's result, streamed the moment it lands. A concrete envelope (NOT a bare
union) so codegen emits one stable type: `agentId` identifies which agent, and exactly ONE
report field is populated (others null). The client merges it into its `ReviewBundle`.
AgentReport.title: AgentReport

AnchorKind.description: What a review thread is pinned to. Anchors are *stable ids*, never array indices.
AnchorKind.title: AnchorKind

Application.description:
A tracked job application. `tailored_cv_ref` is the locked `StoredCV.id`; `job_title` is
server-resolved (request title, else the CV's `cv_labels` title) so it's never blank. `stage` is
the current stage (one of `stages`); `events` is the append-only timeline.
Application.title: Application

ApplicationConflict.description: 409 body carrying a `ConflictCode` discriminator + a human detail.
ApplicationConflict.title: ApplicationConflict

ApplicationSummary.description:
A lightweight row for the tracker list — enough to label, badge the stage, and open the
detail without shipping the full timeline. `applied_at` is the stored time (UTC on the wire).
ApplicationSummary.title: ApplicationSummary

ApplyConflict.description:
A proposal `apply` skipped (e.g. a stale enrich target in PR-E, or a malformed unit) so the
rest of the accepted set still lands — apply is partial, never all-or-nothing.
ApplyConflict.title: ApplyConflict

ApplyFeedbackRequest.description:
Body for `POST /workspaces/{id}/cv/{cvId}/apply` — the accepted **bullet**-anchored threads
to apply as Corrector rewrites. (Named `ApplyFeedbackRequest`; `ApplyRequest` is the tracker's
job-application action.) `baseVersion` is the CV version the client was viewing — the (billed)
correction is rejected 409 if the stored CV changed since, like the edit/review/export guard.
ApplyFeedbackRequest.title: ApplyFeedbackRequest

ApplyRequest.description:
Body for `POST /workspaces/{id}/applications` — lock a finished CV against a job.

Only the CV id + display/tracking metadata cross the wire; the server re-reads the CV, re-checks
the sign-off gate, and resolves the title (this request, else the CV's `cv_labels` title — so a
keyless draft, which has no label, must supply one here, else 422). `base_version` is the CV
version the client was viewing — a stale apply is rejected (409 `stale`).
ApplyRequest.title: ApplyRequest

ApplyResult.description:
Result of applying the accepted proposals: how many landed, what was skipped, and the master
as persisted.
ApplyResult.title: ApplyResult

BulkDecideRequest.description:
Bulk accept/decline. Per-item `baseVersion` keeps the single path's optimistic-lock guarantee
(stale items → reported, not silently clobbered). The server re-derives which proposals are
eligible from stored state — the client's list never widens the gate (invariant 2).
BulkDecideRequest.title: BulkDecideRequest

ConflictCode.description:
Machine-distinguishable 409 reason on the apply / CV-mutation paths, so the client branches
on a code rather than fragile prose. (The needs-sign-off 409 stays `ExportBlocked`, which
already carries `blockedBulletIds`.)
ConflictCode.title: ConflictCode

CreatedCV.description: Result of persisting a tailored CV: its server-generated id + the derived CV.
CreatedCV.title: CreatedCV

CvSummary.description:
A lightweight row for the dashboard CV list — enough to label, badge, and open a CV without
shipping the whole `{master, cv}` bundle. `needsSignoff` is derived from the CV; `jobTitle` /
`company` come from the separate `cv_labels` row (None for a keyless draft). The timestamps are
the stored-row times, not anything inside `cv`.
CvSummary.title: CvSummary

DecideProposalRequest.description:
Accept / decline / edit one proposal. `edited` (a replacement `ProposalContent`) is honoured
on `accept` and `edit`; `baseVersion` is the proposal version the client was viewing — a stale
write is a 409 (optimistic lock), so a stale tab can't admit content it never saw.
DecideProposalRequest.title: DecideProposalRequest

EditBulletRequest.description:
Body for `POST /workspaces/{id}/cv/{cvId}/edit` — a manual text edit of one tailored bullet.
The server owns provenance (invariant 2): only the bullet text is client-supplied; `origin` /
`sourceId` / `needsSignoff` are re-derived server-side. Text is trimmed + bounded, so a blank or
whitespace-only edit is a 422. `baseVersion` is the CV version the client was editing — a write
against a stale version is rejected (409) rather than silently clobbering a newer one.
EditBulletRequest.title: EditBulletRequest

EditorReport.description: Editor agent (OpenAI) — line-edit critique. Critique only, never rewrites.
EditorReport.title: EditorReport

Evidence.description:
The verbatim source span supporting a proposal, so the owner can trust what enters the
master. `verified` is True when the server confirmed the snippet appears in the source
document (best-effort substring check); a non-verbatim snippet is flagged, never gates apply.
Evidence.title: Evidence

ExportBlocked.description: 409 body when export is gated: the bullets still awaiting sign-off (invariant 2).
ExportBlocked.title: ExportBlocked

ExtractedCertificate.description:
LEGACY (DevPR31): ingestion no longer extracts or proposes certificates — none of the four
render outputs nor the master editor shows them, so accepting one sent data into a black hole.
The shape stays because persisted pre-DevPR31 proposals carry it (`ProposalContent.certificate`)
and open runs in prod must still render/apply.
ExtractedCertificate.title: ExtractedCertificate

ExtractedLanguage.description:
A spoken/written language the document states, with fluency when given. Small +
low-optionality (one optional scalar) so folding it into the qualifications Extractor call
doesn't blow the structured-output grammar budget (see agents/extractor.py).
ExtractedLanguage.title: ExtractedLanguage

FactCheckReport.description: Fact-Checker (OpenAI) — every claim must trace to a master bullet.
FactCheckReport.title: FactCheckReport

GatekeeperVerdict.description: Gatekeeper (OpenAI) — simulates the recruiter / ATS first-pass screen for THIS posting.
GatekeeperVerdict.title: GatekeeperVerdict

IngestRelationship.description:
How a proposal relates to the CURRENT master — **server-derived after re-grounding, never a
model output**. `net_new` adds a unit the master lacks; `enrich` appends a new highlight to an
existing work entry (`targetWorkId`); `correction` overwrites an already-set basics field
(`currentValue` shows what it replaces). Only `net_new` is bulk-acceptable — enrich/correction
need a deliberate per-item accept (invariant 2).
IngestRelationship.title: IngestRelationship

IngestRunStatus.title: IngestRunStatus

IngestSourceType.description: Where the ingested document came from (display + future per-source handling).
IngestSourceType.title: IngestSourceType

IngestUnitKind.description:
What a proposal would add to the master. `highlight` enriches an existing work entry with one
new bullet (PR-E); the rest build a whole unit net-new (PR-B1), and a `basics-field` may instead
be a `correction` of an already-set field (carried by `relationship`, PR-E). `certificate` is
LEGACY: no new certificate proposals are built (DevPR31), but persisted pre-DevPR31 runs still
carry them, and review/apply must keep honouring those.
IngestUnitKind.title: IngestUnitKind

IngestVerdict.description:
The Judge's advisory recommendation per proposal (OpenAI adjudication — PR-E E2). Advisory
ONLY: it never gates apply nor widens the bulk gate. An omitted/unknown proposalId, or a Judge
outage, maps to `needs_review`.
IngestVerdict.title: IngestVerdict

IngestionProposal.description:
One reviewable change, anchored to a stable server-minted `proposalId` (invariant 7).

`version` is the optimistic-lock token a decide call echoes as `baseVersion`. `appliedMasterId`
records the master id minted when an accepted proposal was applied. The reconciliation envelope
(`relationship` / `targetWorkId` / `targetLabel` / `currentValue` / `decision`) is
**server-owned and immutable** — `edited` carries only owner content edits, so an owner can
never re-target an enrich or correction (invariant 2). All five default, so pre-PR-E stored
payloads load unchanged.
IngestionProposal.title: IngestionProposal

IngestionRun.description:
One ingestion of one document. `failureKind`/`failureReason` are set when a run ends
`failed`, so a recovered/listed run is self-describing (refusal vs truncation vs down).
IngestionRun.title: IngestionRun

IngestionRunBundle.description: The reload-safe, deep-linkable read backing `/ingest?run=<id>`: the run + its proposals.
IngestionRunBundle.title: IngestionRunBundle

JobSpec.description:
The wire + persisted posting: parsed fields PLUS owner-supplied additions. `postingUrl` is
owner-supplied (the new-application modal) — NOT on `ParsedJobSpec`, so the Parser can't produce
it. Optional + defaulted so legacy `cv_job_specs` blobs (pre-field) still validate.
JobSpec.title: JobSpec

Membership.description: A user's access to one workspace. Absence of a row == no access (deny-by-default).
Membership.title: Membership

Origin.description: Provenance of a tailored bullet — net-new always requires sign-off (invariant 2).
Origin.title: Origin

PasteIngestRequest.description: Body for `POST /workspaces/{id}/ingest` (PR-B1, text path): the pasted CV / LinkedIn text.
PasteIngestRequest.title: PasteIngestRequest

ProposalContent.description:
The proposed master fragment. Exactly one sub-field is set, matching `unitKind` (enforced
server-side): `field` for a basics-field add or correction, `highlight` for an enrich, and
work/education/skill/cert reuse the id-less Extracted shapes for a whole net-new unit.
ProposalContent.title: ProposalContent

ProposalDecision.description:
The Judge's advisory verdict carried on a proposal (PR-E E2) — server-built from the Judge's
structured output, never client-set. Advisory only (invariant 6).
ProposalDecision.title: ProposalDecision

ProposedField.description:
A single basics/identity field. `fieldPath` is a wire path validated server-side against a
typed allowlist (e.g. `basics.name`, `basics.location.countryCode`); `value` is the proposed
text.
ProposedField.title: ProposedField

ProposedHighlight.description:
The proposed new bullet for an `enrich` proposal — text only. The target work entry is the
server-owned `targetWorkId`/`targetLabel` on the proposal envelope, so an owner edits the bullet
text but can never re-point the merge to a different role (invariant 2).
ProposedHighlight.title: ProposedHighlight

ProviderKeyStatus.description: Masked key status — never the secret itself.
ProviderKeyStatus.title: ProviderKeyStatus

ProviderModelStatus.description: Cached available models + the per-tier assignments for one provider.
ProviderModelStatus.title: ProviderModelStatus

RecruiterUpdateRequest.description:
Body for `PATCH …/applications/{id}/recruiter` — sets the WHOLE recruiter contact (a full
replace). Both keys are **required** (`Field(...)`) but nullable, so an *omitted* key is a 422
rather than a silent clear; send `null`/`""` to clear a field. A non-empty email must look like
one (coarse `_RECRUITER_EMAIL_RE`) → 422; the name is free-form.
RecruiterUpdateRequest.title: RecruiterUpdateRequest

RenderBundle.description:
The `{master, cv}` the renderer needs (dates/company resolve off master), plus the stored
`jobSpec` this CV was tailored to (None for a keyless draft). The client uses `jobSpec` for the
posting drawer + Gatekeeper present/met derivation — NOT a render/provenance input (invariant 2;
the renderer ignores it).
RenderBundle.title: RenderBundle

ReviewBundle.description:
The aggregate review result for one CV — each of the four advisory reports, optional. A null
report means that agent didn't apply (N/A for this CV, e.g. a keyless / no-job draft has no
posting so `gatekeeper`/`editor` stay null); an agent that ran and degraded is listed in
`failures` instead. Nothing here gates export; only the sign-off gate does.

`cvVersion` is the EXACT version of the CV the server reviewed (the row it loaded), so the
client can tell whether the review still matches the CV on screen: a save since the review
(or a concurrent edit in another tab) bumps the version, and the mismatch marks the review
version-drifted — a presentation signal only (ADR 0016): its surfaces stay visible,
stale-marked, never hidden.
ReviewBundle.title: ReviewBundle

ReviewDecisionsRequest.description:
Body for `PUT .../cv/{id}/review/decisions` — the client's WHOLE per-finding decisions
snapshot (last-write-wins, invariant 7) plus the `cvVersion` it was viewing. The server rejects
a mismatch against the stored review's version with **409** (the review was re-run since).
Bounded (→ **422**): at most 512 entries, each key at most 512 chars.
ReviewDecisionsRequest.title: ReviewDecisionsRequest

ReviewRequest.description:
Body for `POST /workspaces/{id}/cv/{cvId}/review`. `baseVersion` is the CV version the client
is viewing: the (billed) review is rejected (409) if the stored CV changed since, so a stale tab
never pays for a verdict of a row it isn't showing (matches the export/apply guard).
ReviewRequest.title: ReviewRequest

SavedReview.description:
The persisted latest review run for one CV (ADR 0013) — what `GET .../cv/{id}/review` returns
when a run is stored (200-null when none is). `bundle` is the exact `ReviewBundle` that was
reviewed; `reviewedText` maps `bulletId -> text` at review time (server-derived); `decisions`
maps an opaque client `threadKey -> accepted|rejected` (last-write-wins, invariant 7).
`updatedAt` is the stored-row time.
SavedReview.title: SavedReview

SchemaBundle.description: Not a runtime payload — a codegen anchor that pins every model into the OpenAPI document.
SchemaBundle.title: SchemaBundle

SetProviderKeyRequest.description: Write-only: the raw API key. Validated by listing models before it is stored.
SetProviderKeyRequest.title: SetProviderKeyRequest

SetTiersRequest.description:
Assign a real model id to each tier (None to leave a tier unset). Validated server-side
against the cached available-models list.
SetTiersRequest.title: SetTiersRequest

SignoffRequest.description:
Owner approval of net-new bullets — clears their `needsSignoff`, unblocking export.
`baseVersion` is the CV version the client was viewing: the write is rejected (409) if the CV
has changed since, so a stale tab can't approve text it never saw (optimistic concurrency).
SignoffRequest.title: SignoffRequest

SlopReport.description: AI-Language Spotter (Claude) — model pass that pairs with the deterministic heuristics.
SlopReport.title: SlopReport

StageEvent.description: One entry in an application's status timeline. `at` is server-set (UTC offset on wire).
StageEvent.title: StageEvent

StageUpdateRequest.description:
Body for `PATCH /workspaces/{id}/applications/{id}/stage` — advance the status pipeline. The
stage must be one of the application's `stages` (else 422); the optional note joins the timeline
event the server appends.
StageUpdateRequest.title: StageUpdateRequest

Thread.description: A single anchored critique. `anchorId` is a bulletId / itemId / sectionId.
Thread.title: Thread

ThreadDecision.description:
The owner's verdict on one review finding (ADR 0013). Lives here, NOT in `common.py`, so it
doesn't collide with the Gatekeeper's `Decision` (`pass`/`borderline`/`reject`).
ThreadDecision.title: ThreadDecision

Workspace.description: One isolated tenant. `ownerEmail` is the account that created it; rows scope to `id`.
Workspace.title: Workspace

WorkspaceTailorRequest.description:
Body for `POST /workspaces/{id}/cv` — tailor the workspace's **stored** master to a job. Only
the job is client-supplied; the master is loaded server-side so provenance is always grounded in
stored truth, never arbitrary client JSON (invariant 2).
WorkspaceTailorRequest.title: WorkspaceTailorRequest

info.description: AI CV-tailoring cockpit — agents, persistence, auth, the provenance gate.
info.title: Contender API

put.description:
Validate the key by listing models, then store it + cache the list atomically. A key the
provider rejects → 400, and nothing is stored.

post.description: Parse a pasted job posting into a structured JobSpec (Parser agent, Claude).

Email a sign-in link IF the address is allowlisted. Always returns ok — never reveal who is
on the allowlist.

get.description: Never invoked; exists so every model is part of the OpenAPI schema for TS generation.
Every tracked application in the workspace, newest first (owner-only; invariant 8).

schema.title: Response List Applications Workspaces  Workspace Id  Applications Get

post.description:
Lock a finished CV against a job and move it to the tracker (owner-only). Enforces the export
gate (invariant 2): 409 `ExportBlocked` while any net-new bullet is unsigned. 409 `stale` if the
CV moved since the client read it; 409 `alreadyApplied` if it's already tracked; 422 if no job
title can be resolved; 404 if the CV doesn't exist in this workspace.

schema.title: Response 409 Apply Workspaces  Workspace Id  Applications Post

get.description:
The application tracking this CV as `ApplicationSummary`, or JSON `null` when the CV isn't
applied (owner-gated) — the workspace calls this on every load/refocus to redirect a locked
deep-link to the tracker. Returns 200 `null` (not 404) so the probe never logs a red console
error; a non-member still 403s (invariant 8), and a cross-tenant miss is the same
information-free `null`.

schema.title: Response Get By Cv Workspaces  Workspace Id  Applications By Cv  Cv Id  Get

delete.description:
Remove a tracked application AND the locked CV it froze (owner-only). Unknown/cross-tenant id
→ 404. Returns `200 {ok}` (not 204) so the shared `api()` client, which parses every body,
doesn't throw.

get.description: The full application (job metadata + status timeline) for the owner. 404 if unknown.

patch.description:
Set the whole recruiter contact (name + email) on an application (owner-only). Both keys are
required (an omitted key → 422); a non-empty invalid email → 422 (request validation). 404 if
unknown. Full-replace, last-write-wins (invariant 7).

Advance the status pipeline + append a timeline note (owner-only). 422 for a stage not in the
application's `stages`; 404 if unknown.

get.description:
Every tailored CV in the workspace, newest first, as lightweight summaries for the dashboard
list. Scoped to the path workspace (invariant 8); a non-member fails closed in the auth dep,
never here.

schema.title: Response List Cvs Workspaces  Workspace Id  Cv Get

post.description:
Tailor the workspace's STORED master to the job, run the provenance gate, then persist
(owner-only). The master is loaded server-side (invariant 2): provenance is grounded in stored
truth, never client-supplied JSON. 404 if the owner hasn't saved a master yet.

Build an AI-free **verbatim draft** from the workspace's stored master and persist it
(owner-only). No provider key needed: every bullet is a verbatim copy of a master highlight, so
the draft has zero net-new bullets and export is never blocked — the keyless path that closes
the loop without a key. 404 if no master is stored yet.

delete.description:
Owner deletes a tailored CV and its dashboard label. Unknown or cross-tenant id → **404**
(the store filters on `(workspace_id, cv_id)`, so no other tenant's CV is reachable). Returns
`200 {ok}` (not 204) so the shared `api()` client, which parses every body, doesn't throw.

get.description:
The `{master, cv}` preview bundle. Not sign-off-gated — preview shows net-new bullets so
the owner can decide; export (below) is what the sign-off gate blocks.

post.description:
Owner applies accepted review threads as Corrector rewrites (dec #7). A cheap preflight
rejects a stale/locked CV **before** the billed LLM; the Claude call then runs OUTSIDE any DB
transaction (a session-free authoring runner + a committed preflight), and the short critical
section guards + saves under the lock. v1 corrects only **bullet**-anchored threads (item /
section / summary are advisory-only); the server trusts the client threads as INPUT only — the
output structural guard + selective re-ground decide what persists (invariant 2). 404 unknown
id; 409 stale / locked; 422 a structurally-invalid or blank/oversized correction, or no
correctable bullet thread; 503 if the Anthropic tier/key is unset (preflight).

Owner edits one tailored bullet's text. The server re-grounds just that bullet (invariant 2):
a grounded bullet stays grounded (verbatim→reworded), a net-new bullet stays gated. 422 for an
unknown bullet id; 409 if the CV was changed concurrently (reload and retry).

get.description:
Gate-checked render bundle (invariant 2). 409 with the blocking bullet ids while any net-new
bullet is unsigned; otherwise the `{master, cv}` cleared for render. Owner-only.

delete.description:
Owner clears the persisted review for a CV (the "Clear review" action): wipe the run + its
per-finding decisions so the panel/diff reset. Idempotent — `delete_review` is 0-row-safe, so a
second clear (or clearing a never-reviewed CV) is a **200 no-op**, never a 404. Needs a
commit: `delete_review` rides the caller's transaction (like the GET's orphan-delete).

get.description:
The persisted latest review run for a CV (owner-only), or **200-null** when none is stored
(ADR 0013). Deliberately NOT 404: the rehydrate probe fires on every workspace mount, and a 404
would reintroduce the console noise. A stored bundle that no longer validates against the
current `ReviewBundle` (a schema skew — `CamelModel` is `extra="forbid"`) also reads as
**200-null** with a warning, so a contract change self-heals as "no review" instead of a 500.

schema.title: Response Read Review Workspaces  Workspace Id  Cv  Cv Id  Review Get

post.description:
Run the AI review panel over a stored CV (owner-only) — Editor / Fact-Checker / Spotter and,
when the CV targets a job, the Gatekeeper. The CV + its stored master + `JobSpec` load
server-side (invariants 2 & 8); the adjudicators read the `TailoredCV` JSON (ADR 0010). A
no-job draft runs only the job-independent agents (Fact-Checker + Spotter), so `gatekeeper` /
`editor` stay null. With `Accept: text/event-stream` the panel STREAMS per-agent SSE
(`AgentStarted` / `AgentReport` / `AgentDone`, terminal `RunDone`); otherwise it blocks and
returns the full `ReviewBundle`. **Advisory** — nothing here gates export (invariant 2); only
sign-off does. Provider config (unset tier / missing key) → 503 preflight; a per-agent in-flight
failure DEGRADES (it lands in `failures` / an `AgentDone(ok=false)`), it never fails the request
(invariant 5 is met by surfacing it explicitly, not by an HTTP error).

put.description:
Persist the owner's WHOLE per-finding decisions snapshot for a stored review (owner-only,
ADR 0013) — whole-snapshot last-write-wins at the same review version (invariant 7). **404**
(`ReviewNotFound`) if no review is stored; **409** (`ReviewVersionConflict`) if the stored
review is a different CV version than the client shows (it was re-run since) — the server-side
defense against a stale writer; **422** if the body is over bounds (≤512 entries, ≤512
chars/key).

post.description: Owner approves net-new bullets, clearing `needsSignoff` (idempotent). Unblocks export.

get.description: Runs newest-first — the recovery / history surface (a dropped upload is reachable here).

schema.title: Response List Ingest Runs Workspaces  Workspace Id  Ingest Get

post.description:
Paste a CV / LinkedIn document → run the Extractor → reviewable net-new proposals. With
`Accept: text/event-stream` the same synchronous run is streamed as per-agent SSE progress
(ending in `RunDone{resultRef}`, then the client reloads the bundle); otherwise it blocks and
returns the bundle. See `_prepare_run` / `_execute_run` for the run-row-first / mark-failed /
409 / 503 semantics.

Upload a PDF (a CV, or a LinkedIn 'Save to PDF' export) → extract natively via Claude's
document block (ADR 0007) → reviewable net-new proposals. pypdf supplies the stored text copy
and the byte/page guard (413/422); the run then proceeds as the paste path (with the native
text-only fallback), blocking or — with `Accept: text/event-stream` — streamed as SSE progress.
Owner-only; `sourceType=pasted` belongs to the text route (422).

get.description: The run + proposals (reload-safe, deep-linkable). Unknown / cross-tenant id → 404.

post.description:
Apply the accepted proposals to the master under the advisory lock. 409 if the master changed
since the run started (staleness); 422 if the result isn't a valid master (e.g. first-run
identity
incomplete); partial — conflicts are reported, the rest still lands.

Bulk accept/decline. The server only flips proposals that are genuinely still pending, and on
accept ("Add all new items") only `net-new` ones — so the client's list can't widen the gate
(invariant 2). Unknown id → 404; an enrich/correction in an accept → 422; stale item → 409.
Abandon a run — the escape hatch from a wedged/unwanted run, freeing the workspace.
Accept / decline / edit one proposal (optimistic-locked on its version → 409 if stale).

get.description:
The workspace's stored master (owner-gated), or **200-null** when none has been saved.
Deliberately NOT 404 (probe parity with the review-latest GET): the workspace mount and the
/master editor both probe this on load, and a first-run 404 was console noise for an
expected state, not a fault.

schema.title: Response Read Master Workspaces  Workspace Id  Master Get

put.description:
Owner upserts the workspace's master. 422 on a blank / duplicate / unsafe stable id —
these are the provenance anchors and must be valid before storage.
